verdict.rationale: The engine runtime is described as MIT-licensed, a permissive license. That is corroborated by repeated descriptions of PlayCanvas as an open-source engine, and builds can be downloaded for self-hosting. This implies no royalties or per-install fees on shipped games. The only cost signal in the evidence is an Editor subscription for private projects, which is a seat or plan fee rather than a revenue share. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of no royalties or revenue share, a direct license file or license-page citation, and clarity on licensing terms for the hosted Editor versus the open engine.
